Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Navin Kumar
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Deepak Verma,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A for the State as also perused the
record.

2.  This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed seeking direction to the court below for early decision of Case No.114 of 2020 arising out of Case Crime No.928 of 2018, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C., Police Station- Khurja Nagar, District- Bulandshahar, pending before the court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Khurja, Bulandshahar.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is informant and Investigating Officer submitted charge-sheet in the year 2019 and trial court has taken cognizance in the year 2020 but till today no charge has been framed under the aforesaid offence.
Applicant has filed this application to expedite the trial within stipulated period.
He next submitted that accused persons are not cooperating in the proceeding.

4. Considering the fact that the proceeding in the aforesaid section is pending since 2019 and charges are not framed, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this application is finally disposed of with a direction to the court below to frame the charge within three months and thereafter decide the aforesaid case in accordance with law, as expeditiously as possible, without granting any unnecessary or long adjournments to either of the parties from the date of production of a certified copy of this order, if there is no other legal impediment.
